title: Why We Have Two Eyes
description: Why do we have two eyes instead of one bigger eye? This season opener of Focus Cast by focuslinks opens Season 9 of Series 3, Ocular Physiology, following the colour and contrast season, and it makes the design case for the two-eye layout. Learn the four advantages of paired forward-facing eyes, redundancy, a wider field of view, pooled sensitivity for faint targets, and stereopsis, the depth signal born of two viewpoints a couple of inches apart, and hear the honest cost of that design in continuous aiming precision. The episode also walks the animal kingdom trade between depth and panorama, and maps the nine episodes of binocular and oculomotor physiology ahead. Made for optometry students and practising optometrists who want the reasons behind the layout they test every day.
